result.markdown:
# Planned Fibre Splice Overrun and Transport Failure in Sahel

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** transport_degradation at `LNK-SAH-01-B`
- **Confidence:** medium (Direct alarm evidence on the shared fiber link and sites perfectly matches the maintenance window timing, with changes and other factors checked.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-06 07:15 to 2026-09-06 13:23
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-06 07:16
- **Affected:** S-SAH-007, S-SAH-008, S-SAH-009, LNK-SAH-01-B

## Summary

Planned fibre splice work on shared fiber link LNK-SAH-01-B experienced an overrun, causing an extended critical LINK_LOS and subsequent site outages.

Sites S-SAH-007, S-SAH-008, and S-SAH-009 went offline due to a link loss on LNK-SAH-01-B from 2026-09-06 07:22 until recovery around 13:23.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-06 07:15: Region-level alert starts for S-SAH-007, S-SAH-008, and S-SAH-009 due to active users and availability drops. [ALR-0004, ANM-000109, ANM-000101, ANM-000106]
- 2026-09-06 07:16: Planned maintenance window MW-0004 begins on LNK-SAH-01-B for planned fibre splice work. [MW-0004]
- 2026-09-06 07:22: Critical LINK_LOS alarm raised on LNK-SAH-01-B. [ALM-000100]
- 2026-09-06 07:23: Critical SITE_DOWN alarms raised on S-SAH-009, S-SAH-007, and S-SAH-008. [ALM-000101, ALM-000102, ALM-000103]
- 2026-09-06 09:55: Maintenance window MW-0004 scheduled end time passes while transport outage persists. [MW-0004, ALM-000100]
- 2026-09-06 13:20: LINK_LOS on LNK-SAH-01-B and SITE_DOWN alarms on S-SAH-009 and S-SAH-008 clear. [ALM-000100, ALM-000101, ALM-000103]
- 2026-09-06 13:23: SITE_DOWN alarm on S-SAH-007 clears, concluding the incident impact. [ALM-000102]

## Evidence

- Sites S-SAH-007, S-SAH-008, and S-SAH-009 experienced a hard outage starting around 07:15 yesterday morning. [ALR-0004, T2]
- Topology shows S-SAH-007, S-SAH-008, and S-SAH-009 depend on shared parent fiber link LNK-SAH-01-B. [T3, S-SAH-007, S-SAH-008, S-SAH-009]
- A critical LINK_LOS occurred on LNK-SAH-01-B at 2026-09-06 07:22, leading to site down alarms within one minute. [T5, ALM-000100, ALM-000101, ALM-000102, ALM-000103]
- Planned maintenance window MW-0004 for fibre splicing on LNK-SAH-01-B ran from 07:16 to 09:55, overrunning until the link cleared at 13:20. [T6, T9, MW-0004]
- No unexpected configuration changes were applied to the sites or their parents during the window. [T4, T8]

## Hypotheses

1. **transport_degradation** at LNK-SAH-01-B: confirmed. Directly evidenced by LINK_LOS alarm on LNK-SAH-01-B and coinciding with planned maintenance MW-0004 which overran its scheduled end time. [T5, T6, ALM-000100, MW-0004]
2. **bad_change**: rejected. No changes were recorded on the affected sites or parent nodes during the relevant time window. [T4, T8]

## Ruled out

- T4: Changes check showed no configuration changes on S-SAH-007, S-SAH-008, S-SAH-009 or their parents during the incident window.
- T8: Changes check showed no configuration changes on LNK-SAH-01-B or its parents.

## Recommended actions

- Review fibre splicing procedures to avoid maintenance overruns.
- Improve tracking and alerting for maintenance window extensions.

report.title: Planned Fibre Splice Overrun and Transport Failure in Sahel

confounders.why: A window on LNK-SAH-01-B that ended 204 min before service returned; it explains only the first part of the outage.

truth.notes: trap=near_miss_maintenance; The sites of LNK-SAH-01-B went down inside the maintenance window on LNK-SAH-01-B and stayed down 204 min after it closed: the part inside the window is planned work, the remainder is an unplanned outage and is labelled an incident. Trap: a splice window on the right link covers the start of the outage (LNK-SAH-01-B), but the outage runs hours past its end. Settled by: (1) the outage continues 204 min after the window ends, which fails the time test of the maintenance runbook; (2) LINK_LOS and SITE_DOWN stay active after the window closed instead of clearing with the end of the works.
